name: @mintplayer/ui-core
description: Headless, framework-neutral cores for the @mintplayer/bootstrap design system: component state machines, ARIA prop bags, request lifecycles and scoped styles. Consumed by @mintplayer/ng-bootstrap, @mintplayer/react-bootstrap, @mintplayer/vue-bootstrap and @mintplayer/web-components, each of which renders its own template from these cores.
